name: general-screenwriter
description: General screenwriting workshop for Codex with picturebook, shortdrama, and longform TV type packs, editorial workflow, quality gates, staging planning, and a gated illustration workflow.

interface.shortDescription: 通用编剧创作插件（飞书知识库版）
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native general screenwriting workspace with first-use guided setup and 首次初始化, 多人协作飞书知识库同步与权威检索, active picturebook/shortdrama/longform TV type packs, content-level shortdrama/longform validators, deterministic media exporters, editorial workflow, text craft methodology, benchmark checks, staging planning, structured illustration prompts, explicitly confirmed image generation, and self-contained HTML 预览.

帮我用短剧类型包规划一集强钩子短剧
